desc: HSSEDI is MITRE's DHS-sponsored FFRDC, created on 5 March 2009 and run out of McLean under MITRE's Center for Securing the Homeland. It matters to this board for one specific reason: DHS is the department inside which the Kona Blue proposal - the successor UAP materials-exploitation effort documented in AARO's own historical record report - was pitched and, according to that report, never operationalised. Whatever the truth of Kona Blue, the department that was asked to host a UAP materials programme in the 2010s runs its systems engineering through a MITRE-operated FFRDC and through RAND's Homeland Security Operational Analysis Center. Both FFRDC operators named in Burlison's investigation therefore hold standing DHS engineering and analysis franchises. HSSEDI is included here as an access surface, not as an accusation: no document places HSSEDI in any UAP activity.
